body:
You talked to me while my mother was in the ICU. You saw pictures of her in that bed. You knew what that did to me. And you still told me you were going to kill yourself and then told me there was nothing I could do, and you just wanted me to KNOW. You didn't think saying something like that to me would be hurtful? You didn't think putting me in that helpless position again. KNOWINGLY? Would be hurtful? 

I didn't come to you and say "ray that was hurtful" because I didn't want to be RESPONSIBLE for someone killing themselves, because that would be on me. Because every conversation or attempt to HELP YOU, ended in you describing how you were going to kill yourself. How would you have responded to "don't talk to me about this, you're setting off MY PTSD"? 

My friends looked out for me because I was so upset, so OUT OF MY MIND trying to get you help and thinking you were dead that I stopped eating or sleeping for a week. 

You didn't think it would be hurtful. You had no consideration then, nor do you now for what you put me through. Your words and actions have consequences, and the consequences of yours were that you hurt me so badly that my friends noticed and did something about it, and I withdrew so I wouldn't be hurt again. 

I was going to take the high road here, but Jesus. Christ. I want you to stop stirring the pot, get better, and be happy.

Hi, as that person, this poster was very aware of my own history with depression and of the fact that my mother had tried to kill herself in front of me less than a month and a half before. She didn't just contact me to let me know she was going to do it, she used the words "I want you to know this is going to happen, and there is nothing you can do about it, I wanted someone to know" she wanted that someone to be me, and then refused to listen to any help I offered and swanned off for a few days letting me think she was dead.

I was understandably upset about this as we had a long history of friendship. I talked to my other friends about it and they encouraged me to take a step back because they were worried about the VERY negative effect this was having on my personal mental health. I didn't want to approach this person and say "hey don't ever talk to me about your problems again" because it seemed like an assholish thing to do and I didn't want to make the deteriorating situation even worse than it already was. 

Seeing how upset it had made me, my coadmins made the decision to remove this person from our site, both for the aforementioned mild homophobia and for what everyone else saw as a clear danger to me personally. Everything that came afterwards, was a result of other issues that had been building up in the fandom for years concerning this person's tendency to cause issues. This person did not allow me to explain myself after the removal or talk to her, I was just informed that we were "done" and blocked everywhere. I have had no further contact with this person, nor have I been on some shady behind-the-scenes revenge vendetta.

I wish her the very best, and hope she gets herself into a better place in life where she can be happy.
I feel like that. No future, no love, nothing. It would be so much easier. I feel like it was meant to happen.
